SELECT 
    d.makername AS manufacturer,
    d.modnum AS model,
    ts.devscope AS device_type,
    r.rgbbright AS rgb_brightness,
    r.rgbcoloracc AS color_accuracy,
    r.rgbzones AS num_rgb_zones,
    r.rgbmodes AS rgb_modes,
    r.rgbcolors AS supported_colors,
    r.rgbregistry AS rgb_implementation_quality_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN r.rgbregistry ILIKE '%RGB Quality Classification%' THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS rgb_classification
FROM 
    DeviceIdentity d
JOIN 
    TestSessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN 
    Mechanical m ON d.devregistry = m.mechdevref
JOIN 
    RGB r ON m.mechregistry = r.rgbmechref
ORDER BY 
    rgb_implementation_quality_score DESC;

SELECT 
    d.makername AS manufacturer,
    d.modnum AS model,
    ts.devscope AS device_type,
    r.rgbbright AS rgb_brightness,
    r.rgbcoloracc AS color_accuracy,
    r.rgbzones AS num_rgb_zones,
    r.rgbmodes AS rgb_modes,
    r.rgbcolors AS supported_colors,
    r.rgbregistry AS rgb_implementation_quality_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN r.rgbregistry ILIKE '%RGB Quality Classification%' THEN 'High'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS rgb_classification
FROM 
    DeviceIdentity d
JOIN 
    TestSessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN 
    AudioAndMedia a ON d.devregistry = a.auddevref
JOIN 
    RGB r ON a.audregistry = r.rgbaudref
ORDER BY 
    rgb_implementation_quality_score DESC;

WITH deleted_records AS (
    DELETE FROM maintenance_and_fault mf
    WHERE mf.faultpredscore < 0.05
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM robot_details rd
        WHERE rd.botdetreg = mf.upkeeprobot
        AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM rd.instdateval) > 5
    )
    RETURNING mf.*
)
SELECT * FROM deleted_records;

WITH security_issues AS (
    SELECT 
        dp.profiletrace,
        dp.volgb,
        dp.datasense,
        sp.encstate,
        sp.aclstate,
        -- Calculate DSI and SRS
        (dp.volgb * CASE dp.datasense WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS dsi,
        (
            CASE sp.encstate 
                WHEN 'Full' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Partial' THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END * 
            CASE sp.aclstate 
                WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3
                WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2
                ELSE 1
            END
        ) AS srs
    FROM 
        dataprofile dp
    JOIN 
        securityprofile sp ON dp.profiletrace = sp.profilekey
)
-- Update API security state to 'Review Required' for profiles with potential security issues
UPDATE securityprofile sp
SET apisecstate = 'Review Required'
FROM security_issues si
WHERE 
    sp.profilekey = si.profiletrace AND 
    si.dsi > 100 AND 
    si.srs < 2;

-- Return the updated details for these profiles
SELECT 
    dp.profiletrace,
    dp.volgb,
    dp.datasense,
    sp.encstate,
    sp.aclstate,
    sp.apisecstate
FROM 
    dataprofile dp
JOIN 
    securityprofile sp ON dp.profiletrace = sp.profilekey
WHERE 
    (dp.volgb * CASE dp.datasense WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) > 100 AND 
    (
        CASE sp.encstate 
            WHEN 'Full' THEN 3
            WHEN 'Partial' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END * 
        CASE sp.aclstate 
            WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3
            WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2
            ELSE 1
        END
    ) < 2;
